versions.subject: Add new rule to detect PST export when eDiscovery alert policy is disabled (M365)
versions.detection:
selection:
    eventSource: SecurityComplianceCenter
    Payload|contains|all:
        - 'New-ComplianceSearchAction'
        - 'Export'
        - 'pst'
condition: selection
